slides.label: Verse 1
lines: When I think of Your love and faithfulness,
My heart is filled with endless gratitude

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: For all You have done both seen and unseen
For every promise kept, and
Your mercy ever new

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: No word in any language of men
No sound ever formed, no song ever sung

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Can fully declare the weight of Your goodness
Or measure the depth of Your love, gracious God

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Lord Jesus, I am enthralled by Your love
Overwhelmed by Your faithfulness
My life, You have made a testimony of grace
Your goodness and righteousness

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: I am enthralled by Your love
Filled with the power of Your Spirit
I’m blessed by Your Word
Crowned with Your glory, honour and majesty
Lord, I’m grateful to You

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: My life’s a display of Your mercy and grace
Each day, I see victories in Your name
You blessed me beyond what I hoped for
Lord, I’m so grateful to You

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: Through every season, Your name is my song
As I recount every triumph by Your grace

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: What You have done through the power of Your Word
Will forever declare You are faithful and true

slides.label: Verse 10

slides.label: Verse 12

I pour out my love like incense of praise

slides.label: Verse 13
lines: You are so faithful, righteous and true

slides.label: Verse 16
lines: So I stand in awe of who You are,
Amazed at the wonders of Your grace
With my hands lifted high and
My heart filled with praise
I bless Your holy name
